newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Megawati sues mayor for office closure.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Megawati sues mayor for office closure.

text.p: Indonesia's ousted minority party leader Megawati Sukarnoputri sued East Jakarta's mayor on Tuesday for sealing her temporary office last week on grounds it violated zoning regulations, one of her lawyers said.
Lawyer R.O. Tambunan told Reuters he filed the suit in Jakarta's State Administrative Court on behalf of Megawati.
"The mayor broke the law and his letter of closure was not legal. The closure and sealing of the building were also not legal," Tambunan said by telephone.

Megawati set up the temporary office on September 9 after her supporters were evicted by police from the head office of the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) on July 27. She was ousted as PDI head at a government-backed congress in June.

East Jakarta Mayor Sudarsono sent a letter to Megawati's temporary office on September 23, giving her 72 hours to close it because, he said, it was being improperly used as an office in a residential area.
Her supporters argued that the building had previously been used as an office in the mixed-property neighbourhood.
After a 24-hour extension to the deadline, municipal officers sealed the building on Friday afternoon.
"The mayor did not have the authority to issue that order. It was the authority of the governor," Tambunan said.
The July 27 seizure of the PDI headquarters sparked the worst riots in the capital in more than 20 years.
